plain.text: On a Sabbath, Jesus' disciples picked heads of grain to eat. The Pharisees said this broke the Sabbath. Jesus reminded them that David once ate the sacred bread when hungry, and said God desires mercy, not sacrifice; the Son of Man is Lord of the Sabbath. In the synagogue he asked whether it was lawful to heal on the Sabbath. People would rescue a sheep from a pit, and a person is worth far more. He healed a man's shrivelled hand. The Pharisees began plotting to kill him.

Jesus withdrew, healed many and told them not to make him known. Matthew quotes Isaiah about God's chosen servant, who will not quarrel or shout, will not break a bruised reed or snuff out a smouldering wick, and in whose name the nations will hope.

Jesus healed a man who was blind and mute because of a demon. The Pharisees said he drove out demons by Beelzebul, the prince of demons. Jesus said a kingdom divided against itself cannot stand; if he drives out demons by God's Spirit, then God's kingdom has come. He warned that speaking against the Holy Spirit will not be forgiven. A tree is known by its fruit, and people will give account for every careless word.

Some asked for a sign. Jesus said they would get only the sign of Jonah: as Jonah was three days in the fish, the Son of Man would be three days in the heart of the earth. Something greater than Jonah and Solomon was here. He warned that a life swept clean but left empty can end up worse than before.

Jesus' mother and brothers wanted to speak with him. Pointing to his disciples, he said, Here are my mother and my brothers. Whoever does the will of my Father in heaven is my brother and sister and mother.

summary.bigIdea: Jesus shows that he is Lord of the Sabbath and the gentle servant God promised, even as opposition to him grows.
points: Jesus heals on the Sabbath and says mercy matters more than ritual.
He is the gentle servant who will not break a bruised reed.
Those who do God's will are Jesus' family.
summary.reflection: Jesus will not break a bruised reed. Where do you need his gentleness?
